subject: Clarify invoice sender, delivery path, and VAT evidence pipeline
messages:
From: Greenlane Finance <accounts@greenlane.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Mora <elena.mora@greenlane.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Who will send invoices to Greenlane (portal vs email)?

Hi Connor / Kimberly,

Quick question as we get set up for go-live next month: who will be the invoice originator on your side? Our AP team needs to know whether invoices will come from Redwood's billing system (pushed into Greenlane's portal) or be delivered via email/SFTP from the invoice creator.

Additionally, for EU VAT evidence we typically require either: a) portal-stored PDF with VAT tag + signed remittance, or b) periodic SFTP delivery of VAT proof bundles. Which pipeline can you support?

We're trying to lock this before our purchasing system cutover on 07/01. If possible, please send a sample invoice and any certificate of VAT tagging so our AP team can confirm mapping.

Thanks,
Elena Mora
Accounts Payable Manager
Greenlane Inc.
attachments: sample_requirements_checklist.xlsx (stub)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Greenlane Finance <accounts@greenlane.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Who will send invoices to Greenlane (portal vs email)?

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the timing callout. Short answers up front:

- Invoice originator: Redwood will be the invoice emitter for all hosted/usage charges (we create and sign the invoices).
- Delivery paths: we can support both 1) portal push (we post the PDF into Greenlane's portal via API) and 2) SFTP drop as a fallback for nightly bundles.
- VAT evidence: recommended path is portal-stored PDF with VAT metadata (invoice-level tags) and a monthly SFTP bundle that includes signed remittance and VAT tagging CSV for reconciliation.

I've attached a sample invoice and our VAT tagging doc for EU customers so you can verify fields.

Open items for your AP team:
- Which delivery channel should be primary? (Portal preferred for immediate visibility.)
- SFTP cert exchange: do you prefer SSH key or TLS client cert?
- Remittance fields: confirm whether we should populate \"payer_reference\" vs \"order_number\" for your PO matching.

Kimberly / Marissa — can you confirm SLA and whether we should include an emailed PDF copy to accounts@greenlane.com as a third (opt-in) channel?

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Sr. Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_sample_invoice_202806.pdf (PDF, 120KB), greenlane_eu_vat_requirements.pdf (PDF, 45KB)

From: Elena Mora <elena.mora@greenlane.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jun 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Who will send invoices to Greenlane (portal vs email)?

Hi Connor — thanks, that helps. A few clarifying points from AP: 

1) Portal primary: yes, portal as primary is preferred. We want immediate visibility for newly issued invoices.
2) SFTP fallback: we'll take nightly bundles for archival and for our tax team to ingest. SSH key OK; I'll share the upload path and key exchange contact.
3) Remittance: please populate both payer_reference (our PO number) and order_number where available. We use payer_reference for auto-matching but fallback to order_number when PO missing.

One more ask: for VAT evidence, can you add an invoice-level field named \"vat_tag\" with the EU VAT rate and a boolean \"reverse_charge_applies\" when applicable? If you have a sample CSV layout for the monthly bundle, please include it.

Elena
(On behalf of AP)

Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jun 2028 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Who will send invoices to Greenlane (portal vs email)?

Elena — thanks for the specificity. We will: 

- Make portal push the default channel with immediate availability.
- Provide nightly SFTP bundles (CSV + zipped PDFs) for your tax team; we'll use SSH key exchange. Contact for certs: sec-ops@redwood.com.
- Populate both payer_reference and order_number fields when present; if a PO is not provided we will still include an order_number where possible.
- Add invoice-level fields: \"vat_tag\" (numeric) and \"reverse_charge_applies\" (true/false). We'll include a sample CSV schema in our onboarding packet.

Action items: 
- Connor will share HubSpot contact id and the DocuSign supplier form for KYC so you can complete remittance authority.
- Elena: please share SFTP endpoint and desired username for us to pre-provision.

Thanks — we'll aim to have the portal push test ready by 06/24 and nightly bundle verified by 06/30.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Billing Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
